deadline.value: Applicants who need a UK visa must apply by 2 August 2027 for a September or October 2027 start. The page gives no earlier funding deadline.
deadline.quote: For research courses that start in September and October 2027, the application deadline for students who require a visa to study in the UK is 2 August 2027.

gre_subject.value: The course page does not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: You need a Computer Science supervisor willing to take you on; your research proposal is emailed to a potential supervisor before you apply.
supervisor.quote: You may not be considered for a research degree if you do not have (and we could not identify) an academic willing to supervise your research. | Before you make a formal application, your proposal is emailed to a potential supervisor for their consideration.

entry_route.value: A first-class or strong upper second-class honours degree (or equivalent) is expected; an MSc is desirable but not essential.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should hold (or be expected to obtain) a first-class or strong upper second-class honours degree (or equivalent) | An MSc degree is desirable, but not essential.

notes: Biomedical AI PhD run by the Department of Computer Science; the primary supervisor must be from Computer Science.
